items.title: Quantum computing is helping AT&T solve network problems in seconds: D-Wave CEO
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) has transferred its listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) to the Nasdaq (^IXIC). The quantum computing company has also expanded its network optimization deal with AT&T (T). D-Wave Quantum CEO and president Alan Baratz sits down with Julie Hyman to talk more about its optimization goals for AT&T and other clients.

items.title: AT&T closes $23 billion deal to acquire spectrum from Echostar
items.summary: July 28 (Reuters) - AT&T on Tuesday said it completed its $23 billion acquisition of some wireless spectrum licenses from EchoStar under a deal announced in August 2025.
